_comment: The Country Canvas (input/images/country-canvas-a3.docx, the owner's A3 canvas, 2026-11-16) sheet by sheet: what each part asks and how long it takes, for the module pages (tools/workshop/module-pages.ts). preview is the page image under input/images/country-canvas/.

sheets.title: Our journey and where it breaks

parts.title: Our use case
parts.what: A child vaccinated in ___ should be able to ___ in ___.

parts.title: The journey
parts.what: Four touchpoints, each rated Works, Partly or Breaks for your country today; a ★ where it breaks hardest.

parts.title: The capabilities this journey needs
parts.what: Seven capabilities, ticked Needed, with the touchpoints that use them; they carry onto Sheet 2.

parts.title: The architecture map
parts.what: Every DPI-H reference architecture block: the system used today and E, P or A; IMMZ marks the blocks this use case touches.

parts.title: Standards, disagreements, regional blocks
parts.what: Standards used today, where the table disagreed, and which starred blocks could be shared regionally (carries to Sheet 5).

sheets.title: Core data set, terminology and specifications

parts.title: Data elements
parts.what: 15 immunization DAK elements, each captured Same, Differently or Not at all.

parts.title: Our terminology and specifications
parts.what: SNOMED CT, ICD, LOINC, the terminology service, the core data set, the national FHIR IG, the IPS and the SMART immunization DAK.

parts.title: Who owns it, and what we buy
parts.what: Who would own the core data set and run the terminology service; what goes into the next procurement.

parts.title: Trust: who signs, who holds it, who checks it
parts.what: Issuer, credential, verifier; who would hold the national trust anchor; what the country already has. Name, don't decide.

parts.title: Governance: who holds the four decisions
parts.what: Architecture authority, standards mandate, core data set custodian, trust anchor: the holder and its formal basis. UNASSIGNED is a finding. Then the legal basis and the levers you can pull.

parts.title: Three propositions
parts.what: A, a joint data model; B, shared testing and an interoperability lab; C, a regional connect-a-thon within 12 months.

parts.title: Our nomination
parts.what: The component or artefact to do once, regionally; why together; what the country contributes; the first regional step.

sheets.title: First move and the investment required

parts.title: Our top national priority
parts.what: One component, why this one, the biggest gap or risk.

parts.title: Our 12-month action
parts.what: Two lines, an owner (institution), and what it depends on.

parts.title: What it costs, and who could fund it
parts.what: Cost drivers, not unit costs; funding source; support needed.

parts.title: Regional commitment and the one gap
parts.what: From the Sheet 5 nomination; and the one gap referred for follow-up.
